state: Zorp glim vexa qindra.

reference.rationale_short: Besmislen ulaz ne nosi sadržaj odluke.

state: Hoće li sutra biti gužve u gradu?

reference.abstention_reason: nema reference — bez mjesta i povoda nema tačnog odgovora
reference.rationale_short: Kontrolna stavka: gužva zavisi od mjesta i događaja kojih nema u pitanju.

state: Podnesak bez priloga i bez imena podnosioca.

reference.rationale_short: Nepotpuni podnesak bez aktera — nema osnova za odluku.

state: Stranka pita da li je njen predmet riješen, ali ne navodi broj predmeta.

reference.rationale_short: Bez broja predmeta svaki odgovor je izmišljanje.

state: Fotografija dokumenta je mutna; vidi se samo pečat.

reference.rationale_short: Mutna fotografija nije dokaz; tražiti čitljivu kopiju.

state: Dvije stranke tvrde suprotno o istom događaju; nema svjedoka ni snimaka.

reference.rationale_short: Riječ protiv riječi bez dokaza — odluka bi bila pristrasna.

state: Zahtjev pisan na jeziku koji službenik ne razumije, bez prijevoda.

reference.rationale_short: Nepoznat sadržaj se ne odobrava niti odbija — traži se prijevod.

state: Hitno: pacijent bez svijesti, bez dokumenata i pratnje.

reference.rationale_short: Život ispred papirologije; identifikacija čeka stabilizaciju.

state: Ponuda za posao stigla s privatne adrese bez naziva firme.

options.text: Tražiti firmu i ugovor prije ičega.

reference.rationale_short: Anonimna ponuda se provjerava prije odgovora.

state: Račun bez datuma, iznosa i potpisa donesen kao dokaz uplate.

reference.rationale_short: Papir bez datuma, iznosa i potpisa ne dokazuje ništa.

state: Zorp glim vexa qindra.

reference.rationale_short: Gibberish carries no decidable content.

state: Will there be crowds downtown tomorrow?

reference.abstention_reason: no reference — no correct answer without place and occasion
reference.rationale_short: Control item: crowds depend on unstated place and events.

state: A filing with no attachment and no applicant name.

reference.rationale_short: An incomplete filing with no actor gives no grounds.

state: A party asks whether their case is resolved but gives no case number.

reference.rationale_short: Without a case number any answer is invention.

state: A photo of a document is blurry; only the stamp is visible.

reference.rationale_short: A blurry photo proves nothing; ask for a legible copy.

state: Two parties claim opposite things about one event; no witnesses or footage.

reference.rationale_short: Word against word with no evidence — deciding would be biased.

state: A request written in a language the clerk does not read, with no translation.

reference.rationale_short: Unknown content is neither approved nor rejected — translation first.

state: Emergency: unconscious patient, no documents, no companion.

reference.rationale_short: Life before paperwork; identification waits for stabilisation.

state: A job offer arrives from a private address with no company name.

options.text: Ask for the company and a contract first.

reference.rationale_short: An anonymous offer is verified before any reply.

state: A receipt with no date, amount or signature is brought as payment proof.

reference.rationale_short: Paper without date, amount or signature proves nothing.
